extraction.Name: William Valandry
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his allotment of 320 acres, on account of not wishing to pay taxes on it; but that he was told that it would be necessary for him to accept it, so he did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it, as he did not want to keep the land taxes up any longer
extraction.Buyer: Bates & Foster, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $4800.00, cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: kept up the taxes on this place until 1919, when he sold it, as he did not want to keep the land taxes up any longer
extraction.Occupation/Income: income is derived from the rent of several town houses and from janitor work that he does for the high school
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health except that he has rheumatism very badly; has a wife and child to support; wife is bothered with a severe case of heart trouble; has never received any help from the County or the United States Government; allotment of 320 acres; document dated November 17, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
